Definition: from G2596 and G4762; to turn upside down, i.e. upset:--overthrow.
BiblicalUsage: Jesus overthrew the tables of the moneychangers and the seats of them that sold doves.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the overturned tables are the sign that the temple is for prayer, not for profit.
